newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady amid thin enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady amid thin enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were steady in a typically quiet Monday on expectations of a slight dip later in the day due to poor demand, traders said.
They said 380-cst bunker supplies were offered at about $103/$104 and the 180-cst grade was around $106-$107.
"The enquiries are thin. It's a typical Monday and I am expecting prices to end at about $1.00 less," one trader said.
MDO and gas oil were indicated around $173 and $180 per tonne respectively.
